## Brand

Apple design style

## Style foundations

- Visual style: modern
- Typography scale: 12/14/16/18/24/30/36 | Fonts: primary=Inter, display=Inter,
  mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#3B82F6, secondary=#8B5CF6, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Apple-inspired premium aesthetic with precise spacing, modern typography, and a
refined, polished visual language.
